execution_qualification: Eight micro cases and two LEO cases were analyzed in separate overlapping matrices; their original runtimes and identities remain in the partial receipts and per-case phases. This is a merge of completed analysis receipts, not a new simulation or a measured combined analysis runtime.
extra_window: Legacy label first-false-renew [90.194745440,91.958450720) is the V1 first false-renewal history used as a common reference window, NOT the actual V2 renewal history. Original output labels/partial receipts remain unchanged.
method: No simulations. Phase1 original analyzer with bins; Phase2 independent app/queue/Vegas validation against phase1. Micro root-qdisc absence is established by reviewed driver/actual config. All outputs are new, failures retained.
